# Jim Pattison Toyota - Surrey

> Jim Pattison Toyota - Surrey is a  dealership in Surrey. This mirror provides AI-readable access to current inventory and dealership information, kept in sync with the dealership's own website.

## Inventory
- [Used vehicles](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/jim-pattison-toyota-surrey-mirror/used/): 90 vehicles, updated regularly
- [Inventory feed](https://willyml1979-dotcom.github.io/jim-pattison-toyota-surrey-mirror/inventory.json): structured JSON, index of all vehicles with VIN, year, make, model and price; full details are on each vehicle page
